hero.title: International
hero.subtitle: African Coffee & Cocoa Fair
hero.description: The second edition of the International African Coffee and Cocoa Fair will take place in March 2027 in Montreal. An international event bringing together producers, processors, roasters, chocolatiers and investors to promote the excellence of African terroirs on the North American market.

about.title: About
about.description1: The International African Coffee and Cocoa Fair (SICCAF 2027) is an economic, commercial, professional and cultural platform dedicated to the promotion, valorization and development of African coffee and cocoa sectors on international markets.
about.description2: Following a first edition dedicated to African coffee, the second edition, now expanded to coffee and cocoa, will be held in
about.description3: at ESG UQAM - School of Management Sciences, 1250 Sanguinet Street, Montreal (Quebec) H2X 3E7, Canada.
about.preambleText1: Africa holds a strategic position in global coffee and cocoa value chains. These two products represent not only major agricultural crops for several African economies, but also sectors with significant opportunities for processing, industrialization, export and value creation.
about.preambleText2: In response to this observation, the
about.preambleText3: initiated the International African Coffee and Cocoa Fair to create a professional space allowing African coffee and cocoa stakeholders to present their products, meet partners and develop new business opportunities.
about.goals: SICCAF was born from the desire to:
goalsList: Promote the excellence of African coffee and cocoa
Facilitate trade between Africa and Canada
Encourage investment in coffee and cocoa sectors
Position African coffee and cocoa as reference products on international markets

about.visionText: To make SICCAF an international reference platform for the promotion of African coffee and cocoa, positioning Montreal as a privileged meeting space between African producers and North American markets.
about.missionText: To create an international space for promotion, business networking, expertise exchange and commercial development, enabling African coffee and cocoa stakeholders to access new networks, markets, partners and investment opportunities.
challengesList: Knowledge of North American market requirements
pillarsList: PROMOTE - Highlight the diversity, quality, origins, terroirs and African know-how in the coffee and cocoa sectors
CONNECT - Create professional meetings between African producers, buyers, importers, distributors, investors and Canadian and international partners
TRANSFORM - Encourage local processing and increase the added value of products from African coffee and cocoa
INVEST - Facilitate the identification of investment projects and partnerships in the different value chains

concept.title: From plantation to international market
concept.subtitle: Connecting African excellence to global opportunities
concept.description: SICCAF 2027 is designed as an international platform bringing together, in a single space, the different links of the coffee and cocoa value chains.
concept.pillarsTitle: The event is based on four main pillars:

whyParticipate.title: Why
whyParticipate.subtitle: Participating in the second edition of SICCAF 2027 in Montreal represents a major strategic opportunity for any player in the African coffee-cocoa sector.

reasons.title: Privileged access to the North American market
reasons.description: Canada is one of the world's largest consumers of coffee and chocolate per capita. Participating in SICCAF means positioning your products directly in front of Canadian buyers looking for new flavors and ethical origins.

reasons.title: Direct connection with buyers
reasons.description: Unlike generalist trade fairs, SICCAF brings together exclusively professionals. Networking sessions are designed to lead to contract signings, distribution agreements and concrete business partnerships.

reasons.title: Technology and innovation showcase
reasons.description: Taking place at ESG UQAM, a center of excellence in management, you will have access to the latest trends in international marketing, sustainable packaging and processing technologies that increase the added value of your products before export.

reasons.title: Promotion of 'Made in Africa' and Traceability
reasons.description: The current market demands transparency. SICCAF allows you to highlight your origin labels, certifications (Organic, Fair Trade, Rainforest) and tell the story of your terroir directly to industrial roasters and chocolatiers.

reasons.title: Expertise and standards sharing
reasons.description: Participating in conferences and workshops allows you to understand Canada's rigorous sanitary and phytosanitary standards (CFIA), avoiding costly mistakes in your future shipments.

reasons.title: Investment opportunities
reasons.description: The presence of financial institutions and private investors at the event offers a unique platform to present industrialization projects (grinding plants, local roasting) and obtain financing.
